decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC build directly on the firm's core plate exchanger know-how, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the line.
The marine box cooler line draws on long-established water-cooling expertise with a reported major market share, giving strong related knowledge and clear early signals of success.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler business and the firm's marine service network, so existing knowledge supports assimilating feedback and improving it.
The compact oil cooler is a close extension of the firm's exchanger portfolio for transportation and industrial uses, though only a brief website mention makes its performance less visible.
Finned tubes for air coolers rest on core tube and air-cooler engineering and manufacturing capabilities, allowing the firm to learn from service work and keep improving them.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are a technology component that strengthens multiple exchanger types and benefits from the firm's R&D-related absorptive capacity.
